ir.name: pairwise_margin_adaptive_scaled_bias_v5_repaired_fixed
ir.intuition: Replace unsupported pow operator with equivalent squared difference via mul to fix runtime error while preserving original variance calculation and adaptive bias weighting.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
abs_delta_rank_mean = mean(abs(delta_rank)) + 1e-6
delta_rank_mean = mean(delta_rank)
delta_rank_var = mean((delta_rank - delta_rank_mean) * (delta_rank - delta_rank_mean)) + 1e-6
beta = 0.1 * exp(-delta_rank_var * 5)
bias_dynamic = bias * sign(delta_rank) * (abs(delta_rank) + 0.1) / (abs_delta_rank_mean + 0.1)
scaled_bias = tanh(gamma * bias_dynamic)
margin_scale_raw = sqrt(delta_rank_var) / abs_delta_rank_mean
margin_scale = 1.5 * (1 / (1 + exp(-5 * (margin_scale_raw - 0.1))))
scaled_margin = margin * margin_scale
weighted_margin = alpha * scaled_margin - beta * delta_rank
biased_margin = weighted_margin + scaled_bias
x = clamp(biased_margin, -15, 15)
loss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(x)
weighted_loss = loss_per_pair * weight
loss = sum(weighted_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-6
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    bias = float(extra.get('bias', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('bias', 0.5)))
    gamma = float(extra.get('gamma', 2.0))

    abs_delta_rank_mean = ops.mean(ops.abs(delta_rank)) + eps
    delta_rank_mean = ops.mean(delta_rank)
    delta_rank_diff = ops.sub(delta_rank, delta_rank_mean)
    delta_rank_var = ops.mean(ops.mul(delta_rank_diff, delta_rank_diff)) + eps

    beta = ops.mul(0.1, ops.exp(ops.neg(ops.mul(delta_rank_var, 5.0))))

    # sign replaced by equivalent stable operation: delta_rank / (abs(delta_rank) + eps)
    sign_delta_rank = ops.div(delta_rank, ops.add(ops.abs(delta_rank), eps))

    bias_dynamic = ops.mul(bias, ops.mul(sign_delta_rank, ops.div(ops.add(ops.abs(delta_rank), 0.1), ops.add(abs_delta_rank_mean, 0.1))))
    scaled_bias = ops.tanh(ops.mul(gamma, bias_dynamic))

    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    margin_scale_raw = ops.div(ops.sqrt(delta_rank_var.clamp(min=eps)), abs_delta_rank_mean)
    margin_scale = ops.mul(
        1.5,
        ops.div(
            ops.ones_like(margin_scale_raw),
            ops.add(
                ops.ones_like(margin_scale_raw),
                ops.exp(ops.neg(ops.mul(5.0, ops.sub(margin_scale_raw, 0.1))))
            )
        )
    )
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(margin, margin_scale)

    weighted_margin = ops.sub(ops.mul(alpha, scaled_margin), ops.mul(beta, delta_rank))
    biased_margin = ops.add(weighted_margin, scaled_bias)
    x = ops.clamp(biased_margin, -15.0, 15.0)

    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)
    loss = ops.sum(weighted_loss)
    return loss
